name: Sleep Quality
whyItMatters: Sleep strongly impacts cognition, emotional regulation, and execution reliability.
actions: Set fixed sleep and wake times for the next 7 days.
Use a 30-minute low-stimulation wind-down without screens.
No caffeine after midday and track sleep score daily.

name: Stress Regulation
whyItMatters: High stress load narrows thinking and reduces decision quality.
actions: Run a 5-minute downshift protocol (slow exhale breathing) before deep work.
Take one 10-minute no-phone regulation walk daily.
Reduce daily commitments by one low-impact task.

name: Goal Direction
whyItMatters: Clear direction reduces cognitive drag and improves meaningful progress.
actions: Define one weekly outcome with a measurable success metric.
List top 3 priorities and delete one non-essential commitment.
Review progress at end of each day in 3 bullet points.

name: Execution Reliability
whyItMatters: Consistent action is the main bridge from intent to results.
actions: Schedule one non-negotiable deep-work block at the same time daily.
Break first task into a 15-minute starter step.
Track completion rate and protect momentum with no zero days.

name: Relational Quality
whyItMatters: Meaningful connection is a major predictor of wellbeing and life satisfaction.
actions: Initiate one meaningful check-in with a trusted person.
Set one clear boundary on a draining interaction.
Plan one no-agenda connection moment this week.

name: Income Confidence
whyItMatters: Financial security affects stress, agency, and long-term decision quality.
actions: Run one revenue-producing action before noon each weekday.
Track pipeline counts daily: outreach, conversations, proposals, closes.
Review weekly cashflow and set one clear money target.

name: Meaning and Joy
whyItMatters: Positive affect and meaning increase resilience and long-term sustainability.
actions: Schedule one daily joy anchor before work ends.
Capture one gratitude and one win each evening.
Protect one meaningful activity block each week.
